description: Phase 8D §6 Golden Reference Restructure. architecture-language 类别 manifest. brand-agnostic, 跨 brand 共享. Phase 8D §7 强调: 不要把 brand-specific 元素混入 architecture-language.

organic-flow.label: Organic Flow (流动曲线 / 软边界)
organic-flow.description: 曲面代替直角, 软边界代替硬墙, 流动过渡代替强制分隔. 跨 industry 适用 (medical, restaurant, retail, health).

translucent-boundary.label: Translucent Boundary (半透明 / 软边界)
translucent-boundary.description: 半透明介质切分空间, 视觉连续 + 听觉弱屏蔽. 跨 industry 适用.

soft-light-system.label: Soft Light System (嵌入光 / 建筑发光)
soft-light-system.description: 嵌入光 + 顶底缝光 + 膜天窗, 没有任何直接射灯. 跨 industry 适用.

material-continuity.label: Material Continuity (材质连续 / 受控材质数)
material-continuity.description: 材质跨表面流动, 受控材质数 (3-5), 不用混搭. 跨 industry 适用.
